svg.title: Study lighting carrier and first-release detail
svg.desc: Source-derived geometric review. Luminaire symbols show placement and intended use, not measured light distribution or accepted materials.
svg.text: The service corner · actual carrier and first release
Dead-mock-up geometry · fixed islands stay independent · anchors, circuit, materials and physical trial unqualified
Positive front carrier
260 × 450 × 2 mm frame
Four positive front fixings; two fixed side rails
Hard lands carry loads directly to masonry
No load through decoration or mineral board
Depth and actual demand
Core face Y 3177.5 mm; datum is not decorative face
Module G 29.430 N; face moment 5.2974 Nm
Core moment 7.5046 Nm (includes 75 mm stand-off)
Fixing rows 420 mm apart; couple 17.8682 N
Equal upper fixing 8.9341 N; no anchor rating inferred
Carrier stock upper comparison 0.84152 kg
Remaining 2.15848 kg is a budget, not actual installed mass
Riser centre X 1044; side-entry radius 70 mm
Outer bend requirement 80 mm; three independent fixed boxes
Factory bracket pattern, cable/tail and protective closures need actual component detail
Study source interface is unconnected: no current feeder/protection/cable is invented
Removal follows factory body/bracket access after isolation and support
Full module is released only after the electrical disconnection is safe
Real box depths behind the finish · enlarged
Socket box d 28..75 mm; fixed island interrupts decoration
Junction d 13.5..60.5; own cover; carrier d 62.5..64.5
Full fitting + module first rest
Draw 50 mm, translate into rest, then lower upright into captive cradle
Parked module Z 100..550 mm; cradle 300 × 300 mm
Complete swept footprint has 0 current furniture conflicts
Cradle capacity/floor support, actual human handling and full supplied tail remain unqualified
Ordinary infill: support → release four front screws → normal draw; fixed electrical islands and reveal remain closed.
Never enable an opened repair enclosure. Reconnect earth/strain relief, reinstate closures and verify before energising.
